body.statement: For proper blocked edge-coloured directed acyclic graphs, in which every edge-colour block has at least two members, equality of the associated linear Gaussian covariance models implies equality of the coloured directed acyclic graphs.

source.verbatim_statement: Theorem 5.17. Let [G,c] be the model equivalence class of a BPEC-DAG (G,c). Then |BP intersect [G,c]| = 1; i.e., an edge-colored DAG is structurally identifiable in the set of BPEC-DAGs.

attestation.note: Verified by main against arXiv:2404.04024v3 downloaded from https://arxiv.org/pdf/2404.04024v3, Theorem 5.17 on manuscript page 19. BPEC-DAG is the paper's name for a blocked, properly edge-colored DAG, so the cited node is exactly the theorem's structural-identifiability implication.
